description: A utility object for handling IO encryption and decryption streams in Apache Spark, including methods for creating encrypted/decrypted streams and channels, key generation, and IV creation.

classes.name: CryptoHelperChannel
classes.description: A workaround class for ensuring all bytes are written to the underlying channel, used internally in encryption stream handling.

classes.name: CryptoParams
classes.description: A helper class encapsulating cryptographic parameters such as key specification and transformation, initialized with a key and Spark configuration.

methods.name: createCryptoOutputStream
methods.description: Wraps an OutputStream with CryptoOutputStream for encryption, writing an IV first.

methods.name: createWritableChannel
methods.description: Wraps a WritableByteChannel with CryptoOutputStream for encryption, writing an IV first.

methods.name: createCryptoInputStream
methods.description: Wraps an InputStream with CryptoInputStream for decryption, reading the IV first.

methods.name: createReadableChannel
methods.description: Wraps a ReadableByteChannel with CryptoInputStream for decryption, reading the IV first.

methods.name: toCryptoConf
methods.description: Converts SparkConf to Properties for cryptographic configuration.

methods.name: createKey
methods.description: Generates a new encryption key based on Spark configuration parameters.

methods.name: createInitializationVector
methods.description: Generates a secure random IV, logs warning if creation takes longer than 2000ms.
